title: Bouquet
creator: Renee Du
thumbAlt: Placeholder for my own screen recording of Bouquet
hook: Lift flowers out of photos and arrange them into a swaying 3D bouquet.

sections.what: Lift flowers out of photos and arrange them into a swaying 3D bouquet, then wrap it in cellophane.
sections.special: Every motion has weight. Flowers trail behind my finger, swing like pendulums, and settle when I let go. It feels like handling something real.
sections.trick: The flowers are cut out of the photos in advance and shown as flat images, gently cupped by a shader. It looks photographic without any heavy 3D models.
sections.alive: Springs and layered sine-wave wind, so nothing snaps and no two flowers move in sync.
sections.stack: One HTML file, three.js r128, vanilla JS, canvas-drawn textures.
sections.steal: Cutouts plus spring physics for any collect-and-arrange interaction. Tactile without being heavy.
